note: This file declares requested desktop choices; it does not itself start a compositor. The live userspace must parse chm.desktop=aurora|marine|freexp|freewin11, validate the installed session manifest, launch the selected session, and emit a real readiness marker. FreeXP and FreeWin11 are prototypes and are not yet production boot-ready.

fallback.reason: desktop session missing, compositor startup failed, or readiness timeout
